# Lint regex size limit and legacy fancy-regex

The lint rules crate compiles user patterns with `RegexBuilder::size_limit(8 * (1 << 20))`. A pattern over that limit returns `Error::CompiledTooBig`, and the rule loader reports the rule id instead of aborting. The regex crate has no lookaround or backreferences, so rules that need them live in `rules/legacy/` and use `fancy-regex`.

The thumbnail job renders SVG with `resvg --skip-system-fonts --use-fonts-dir assets/fonts --dpi 192`, so the output does not depend on the fonts installed on the runner. ## Summary

Investigated recurring pod evictions on Kubernetes node worker-node-7 in -home-ops-cluster, finding DiskPressure True with /var/lib/containerd Image filesystem at 94% used. Raised imageGCHighThresholdPercent to 95 in kubelet config, reset it to 80 in node-config DaemonSet, restarted kubelet, and pruned unused images with crictl rmi --prune; verified DiskPressure cleared to False via kubectl describe node | grep DiskPressure.
